),
emp_bnum AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN office_location LIKE '%-%' THEN SPLIT_PART(office_location,'-',1) ELSE NULL END AS building_number

),

),

# Aggregate CIS course counts per building using mapped proxy
sql = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT building_key, COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS cis_course_count
  FROM cis_subjects_mapped_building
  WHERE building_key IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY building_key
)
SELECT b.building_key, b.building_name, COALESCE(c.cis_course_count, 0) AS cis_course_count
FROM buildings_lookup b
LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.building_key = b.building_key
WHERE c.cis_course_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cis_course_count DESC, b.building_key
LIMIT 50
"""
